o.text: From Proto-Turkic *sekiŕ. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰾𐰚𐰔 (sekiz, “eight”), Turkish sekiz, Chuvash саккӑр (sakkăr), etc.
Morphologically from aydın (“clear”) + -lıq. Cognate with Turkish aydınlık.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish نسه (nese), نسنه (nesne), from Proto-Turkic *nē erse. Equivalent to nə (“what”) + -sə. Cognate with Turkish nesne.
From Arabic أَجْلَاف (ʔajlāf), plural of جِلْف (jilf).
Borrowed from Russian электрометрия (elektrometrija). By surface analysis, elektro- + -metriya.
